author: Ubisoft
description:
TWO NEW LEGENDARY HERO SKINS!

The new skins let you take on the appearances of The Nightstalker & Liana the Pale, the infamous bloodthirsty duo ravaging Guljin's borders.

And don't miss out on the following content available until November 12th: The Skin of a Killer Effect (5,000 Steel), Bequeath Unto Me Emote (7,000 Steel), Don’t Cross Me! and Winged Death Growl Executions (10,000 Steel each), Blood Magic and Crimson Bloom Eternal Mythic Outfits (15,000 Steel each).

About For Honor:
Step into the battlefield to experience the chaos and glory found only in For Honor. 

Whether battling through a gripping campaign or clashing with others in intense multiplayer modes and PvP modes, players choose from history’s deadliest warriors, each from a fierce rival faction — the bold Knights, the brutal Vikings, the deadly Samurai, the fearsome Wu Lin, and the enigmatic Outlanders.

author: Ubisoft
description:
For those who… come from Montpellier?
Fight for the Glade of Dreams as Rayman and Barbara in their “Baguette outfits”, a nod to an iconic studio and game!

Get them for free when Rayman Legends Retold launches on December 3! Pre-order now: https://raymanlegendsretold.com

About Rayman Legends Retold:
Embark on a bold reimagining of the critically acclaimed platformer, enhanced with stunning 3D visuals and an immersive new story leading to a mysterious new realm. Play the adventure solo or in up to four‑player couch co‑op, jam through all‑new musical stages, saddle up for epic dragon rides, and more!
